text:
maria: Heads-up — sudden jump in 5xx from hosted-api in us-west-2 starting ~09:14 UTC after today's canary batch.
deploy-bot: deployed canary 0.6.3 at 09:12 UTC (route_weight=15, header_normalizer=trim_v2, prefetch=false)
jon: Looking at edge logs — ~70% are 502/gateway from proxy -> inference pool. A chunk show `auth=invalid` upstream.
lee: Support got a ticket from acme-inc, hitting consistent 502s on generate endpoint. They sent this curl:
lee: ```curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'``` 
maria: I can reproduce locally hitting canary shard — response headers show `x-inference-upstream: 502` and `x-trace-id` values.
jon: Quick log snippet (edge -> runtime):
jon: ```[09:13:21] proxy-42 -> runtime-7: upstream returned 502 (AuthError: signature mismatch)
[09:13:21] runtime-7: header_normalizer.trim_v2 applied -> Authorization header truncated to 768 bytes
[09:13:21] runtime-7: downstream auth validation failed -> 502``` 
maria: That aligns — trim_v2 was supposed to compress whitespace but is chopping mid-token for long bearer tokens.
priya: I'm taking oncall — pausing canary traffic and starting rollback to 0.6.2 now. Notifying infra to hold rollout.
jon: Hold pause for a sec — can we toggle the flag instead of full rollback? If we flip header_normalizer back to trim_v1 it should stop truncation.
deploy-bot: flag update request applied to canary at 09:19 UTC: header_normalizer=trim_v1
maria: After flag flip, 5xx rate dropped from ~18% -> ~2% in the last 3m. Some residual 502s for in-flight sessions.
lee: Customer update: told acme-inc we're mitigating and asked for any replay headers/examples. They want ETA on full rollback vs config revert.
priya: Canary traffic set to 0 at 09:22 UTC as a precaution, rollback not required now but we'll keep canary paused until patch lands.
jon: Root cause summary I'll file: trim_v2 has an unsafe slice that truncates Authorization at arbitrary index when token length > 512. Breaks signature check.
jon: Fix PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/487 (safe-trim + unit tests, adds e2e for long bearer tokens)
maria: Post-incident tasks: 1) add gating to flag flips that touch header normalization, 2) add canary smoke test for auth header lengths, 3) run across regions.
tim: Customer-success: I'll send customer a short summary and mitigation steps; will request any additional logs from them.
lee: Closing support loop once PR merges and canary passes regression tests. Thanks all :thumbsup:
priya: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Will schedule follow-up postmortem and assign owners.
jon: Note for follow-up: check if any cached sessions had stale signatures; run a short job to revalidate tokens seen during window.
maria: Filing ticket now with timeline and tracelogs. Will attach sample trace ids: trace=trace-09-131, trace-09-217
lee: Acked. I'll mark the support ticket as 'mitigated' and keep open until postmortem.
priya: Great work — thanks for quick flag toggle and verification.
